parse.title: Waterfall Quest/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
===The Treasure===
'''''Items required:''' [[Rope]].''
{{Checklist|
*Speak to [[Almera]] north-east of [[Baxtorian Falls]]. {{Chat option|1How can I help?}} (use Games Teleport to Barbarian Outpost and head south to the top of the hill)
*Board the raft west of the house.
*Speak to [[Hudon]]. '''Make sure to go through all dialogue or the upcoming book will not spawn.''' 
*Walk to the southern end of the island and swim in the water.
*Enter the large building to the north, where [[Hadley]] is.
*Go upstairs and search the southernmost [[bookcase (Waterfall Quest)|bookcase]] on the eastern wall for a [[Book on Baxtorian]].
*Left-click ''Read'' [[Book on Baxtorian]] and close the book again, or the key will not appear for the next part.}}
